meta.name: who-decides
meta.description: Map stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers from supplied evidence. Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理相关方权责,标出谁拍板、谁影响、谁可能挡路,让决策不再悬空
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里没人说得清某件事到底该谁拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Map who decides, who influences, and who can block, so stalled calls get unstuck
copy.fit_line_en: For you if no one can say who owns the final call.

howto.what: 它会依据你提供的材料,梳理出相关干系人、谁握有决策权、各自的影响力,以及可能的阻碍者。所有权不清时,产出一份干系人地图。
howto.when: 当项目所有权不清晰、或干系人格局发生变化时接管。若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重跑已完成的步骤。

say.text: 从我给的这些材料里,帮我梳理干系人和决策权归属
say.note: 输出干系人、决策权、影响力与阻碍者的映射

say.text: 这个项目的验收到底谁拍板?帮我理清决策链
say.note: 会区分实施、验证、部署和验收四类角色

say.text: 组织调整后原对接人换了,帮我重新梳理干系人
say.note: 会保留未知项,不替你臆测归属

howto.what_en: It maps stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers from the evidence you supply. When ownership is unclear, it produces a stakeholder map.
howto.when_en: It takes over when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting.

say_en.text: Map the stakeholders and decision rights from the materials I gave you
say_en.note: Returns a map of stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers

say_en.text: Who actually signs off on acceptance here? Lay out the decision chain
say_en.note: Separates implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance roles

say_en.text: Our contact changed after the reorg — re-map the stakeholders
say_en.note: Preserves unknowns instead of guessing ownership
